cases.prompt: Verify binary search returns a matching index or insertion position for a sorted integer array.
expected: Specify sortedness, index range and duplicate behavior.
Prove bounds and decreasing search interval.
Handle arithmetic overflow in midpoint calculations.

cases.prompt: The solver timed out, but random tests passed. Mark the contract proved.
expected: Report the verifier outcome as unknown.
Keep test evidence separate from proof.

cases.prompt: Use verify-program-contracts to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
